column2: text (a gloss or remark labelled as ours, in a form the script does not replace)

Sāyaṇa's gloss, quoted here: द्यावापृथिव्यौ यॆष्टुं (दीर्घमायुः) जीवनं प्रभूतं अन्नं वा (प्रसारयतः) संपादयतः (*dyāvāpṛthivyau yèṣṭuṃ (dīrghamāyuḥ) jīvanaṃ prabhūtaṃ annaṃ vā (prasārayataḥ) saṃpādayataḥ*) (यॆष्टुं (*yèṣṭuṃ*) for the bhāṣya's यष्टुं (*yaṣṭuṃ*)). Heaven and earth produce abundant food

(Continuation of the gloss of the preceding word: “without decay”,) and of luminous nature; घर्मः (*gharmaḥ*)—the Āditya, who is of luminous nature, is another form of mine, and; हविः अस्मि नाम (*haviḥ asmi nāma*)—I am myself also the oblation fit to be enjoyed, am I not.
